scripts.build: find contracts -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -not -name archive | xargs -P 4 -I {} sui move build --build-env testnet --path {}
scripts.build:decoder: npm run extract:errors && npm run compile:decoder && npm run prepare:decoder
scripts.dev:decoder: npm run extract:errors && npm run compile:decoder -- --watch
scripts.lint: find contracts -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -not -name archive | xargs -P 4 -I {} sui move build --build-env testnet --lint --path {}
scripts.prepare:decoder: cd tools/error-decoder && cp index.html styles.css error-map.json dist/
scripts.test: find contracts -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -not -name archive | xargs -P 4 -I {} sui move test --build-env testnet --path {}
